Boat incidents result in multiple deaths and missing persons

Several boat capsizing incidents have been reported across different locations, leading to fatalities and missing individuals. In Kerala, two bodies were recovered after a boat capsized in rain-swollen fields. Separately, off the coast of Visakhapatnam, six fishermen are missing after their boat capsized, though one was rescued. International reports detail three deaths after a boat capsized on a Wisconsin lake during storms, and six feared dead after a charter boat sank off the Canadian coast.
